Done! Your build is now clean. The real error was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of reading it from the environment parameter (`env.retries`). The fix was a one-liner: change `maxRetries: retries` to `maxRetries: env.retries || 0`.

The build now completes successfully with the three legitimate warnings intact (deprecated API, unused export, circular import) but zero errors.
